metadata.label: Replay: McDougall Creek wildfire (2023-K52767, 2023)

referenceEvents.event: Fire first spotted, less than a hectare
Evacuation alerts for 4,800 properties in West Kelowna and on Westbank First Nation land
First evacuation orders (already in place by a 7 p.m. news conference)
Fire crests the ridge toward Traders Cove and West Kelowna Estates
Homes lost overnight; fire estimated at 10,500 ha
At least 35,000 people under evacuation orders
BC Wildfire Service declares the fire held

assumptions: Size, stage of control and location are CWFIS agency-reported values at the reported times.
Sizes between reports are linearly interpolated every 6 h (isReported = false).
Reported size is made non-decreasing; small downward revisions are smoothed out.
Fire extent is a circle with the reported area around the reported point, not a mapped perimeter.
Weather alerts are not replayed (no ECCC archive); other fires active at the time are not included.
Scores use the same rules as wildfire_pipeline.py.
